message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on a wedding guest-book-style plaque. Wooden decorative plaques are normally classified in 4420.90 (wooden articles of furniture/ornaments), or 4420.19 for statuettes and other ornaments. Wall plaques made of wood are generally classified in 4420.19.00, now with subdivisions: 4420.11 (statuettes and other ornaments of tropical wood), 4420.19 (other), and 4420.90 (other).

Some rulings classify "wood wall decor" under 4420.19.0000 or 4420.99.8000. After the 2022 changes, 4420.19.00 became 4420.19.0000 for "other" statuettes and ornaments of wood. The plaque is a decorative ornament, and its components are wood (MDF and plywood), so heading 4420 fits. A plaque with pens would be a set, but the wood plaque gives the essential character.

The statistical suffix for 4420.19 is 4420.19.0000, which I believe is the 10-digit code. I'm unsure of the exact suffix, but I'll go with 4420.19.0000. The alternative, 4420.90.8000, is for other wooden articles.

I'll answer with 4420.19.0000.
